verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents a GraphQL API for managing projects. The docs show querying items, adding issues, pull requests and draft issues, updating single select field values, and making a project public. However, nothing in the evidence shows that every UI capability is exposed through the API. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of views (table/board/roadmap), insights and charts, built-in workflows, project status updates, and templates; an explicit statement of full UI/API parity; and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
